_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Photographic Requirements
summary: Specifies the photographic documentation required to demonstrate correct markings on the sonobuoy, launch container, shipping and storage container, and pallet for the procuring activity.
use_relationship:
The Photographic Requirements are used to provide the procuring activity with documented photographs demonstrating the required markings for the bare buoy, Sonobuoy Launch Container (SLC), CNU-239/E Shipping and Storage Container, and Pallet in the associated views as required below.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

children.title: The photographs described in succeeding paragraphs
children.content: shall be exact representations of the production markings for the subject contract and shall be a resolution not less than 96 dpi. All marking shall be complete to include Naval Ammunition Logistics Code (NALC), National Item Identification Number (NIIN) or National Stock Number (NSN), Packing Date, etc. Multiple views may be incorporated into a single photograph, provided the marking in each view is easily discernible.

children.title: Sonobuoy, Sonobuoy Launch Container (SLC) and CNU239/E Shipping and Storage Container (when required) circumferential marking (2 views)
children.content: each shall show the entire length of the sonobuoy, SLC and Shipping and Storage Container standing on end. Each view shall show a 180 degree segment of the sonobuoy, SLC, and Shipping and Storage Container oriented in such a manner as to best depict the marking.

children.title: Sonobuoy, SLC and CNU-239/E Shipping and Storage Container (when required) end marking
children.content: each view shall show an end that is marked. Orientation shall be such that the marking is readable. SLC shall be shown with end cap in place.

children.title: Pallet Marking
children.content: each view shall show a pallet side that is marked. Orientation shall be such that marking is readable. The views may be shown in one or more photographs.

children.title: Written descriptions of each photograph to include
children.content: item nomenclature, contractor's name and contract number.
